# Memmy v1.1.9-rc.1

## Integration candidate

- Integrates the v1.1.9 Memory baseline with consent gated Computer History, personal WeChat History source controls, and reviewed Skill links.
- Adds a shared Agent browser session, Computer Use side panel and live macOS window preview, with Chrome and Edge extension pairing for explicitly claimed tabs.
- Adds per app desktop approval, site and download approval, browser annotations and manual autofill, plus a local Excel task pane bridge.
- Packages the integrated Mac and Windows desktop runtimes with their native Computer Use helpers.

## Validation scope

This is a local test candidate. Locked Mac use still requires a separate authorization plugin and guardian. Excel and Windows native application control require host testing before release. The Memory service keeps its independent version.
